Solid Waste: Municipal Waste Disposal (page 80) - This section should be corrected to indicate that Boston does not dispose of all its solid waste at Gardner Street.
Sanitary Landfills: (page 81) - This section must be revised to indicate that the approval process is now handled by D.E.Q.E. and not the Department of Public Health. The applicable legislation is Section 150A of Chapter III and not Section 105A as indicated. In addition, it should be noted that the sanitary landfills that might accept Boston's demolition wastes have limited capacities.
Table 13: (page 83) - This table in general should be revised. The blanket heading of "Not Participating in Approval Process" should be altered to indicate non-approved status as per 150A/111 and the "Regulations for the Disposal of Solid Waste by Sanitary Landfill" as promulgated thereunder. This listing as submitted is an oversimplification as many of the sites mentioned are in fact involved in enforcement proceedings. It is suggested that D.E.Q.E. personnel be contacted relative to up-dating this section.
Any questions relative to comments on solid waste, please contact the Division of General Environmental Control, Mr. Paul Anderson, Director, at 727-2655.
